WPSS No.1999 of 2019
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Mohit Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, learned Additional Chief 
Standing Counsel with Mr. B.S. Koranga, learned Brief 
Holder for the State.
3. There is no representation for respondent nos.2 to 4.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner 
that the respondent has not filed their counter affidavit since 
2019, despite opportunity.
5. In this view of the matter, in the interest of justice, 
four weeks’ and no more time is granted to learned counsel 
for respondent nos.2 to 4, by way of last opportunity, to file 
counter affidavit.
6. List this case on 18.06.2024.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
